description: Surface the shell exposes to the Panel webview. `core:window:allow-start-dragging` is required for the macOS overlay-titlebar drag strip. The shell no longer exposes any custom Tauri commands — the directory picker and project creation flows route through the gateway's `fs.*` / `projects.*` JSON-RPC instead, which works identically for desktop, localhost web, and remote Tailnet web (R6 — one core, many channels).
